planning_effect_rationale: A deliberately shrunken alternative relative to the accessed v1.3.1 holdout estimate of 1.0477; 0.50 and 1.00 are retained as sensitivity scenarios.
planning_test: one-sided Wald test from the same standardized five-predictor logistic model; the final external endpoint remains the predeclared parametric bootstrap
failure_policy: Nonconvergence, singular information, or a simulated single-class sample counts as a failed rejection.
